name: Prediction Buffer Voxel Traversal
definition: A dataset traversal technique that uses a prediction buffer (a modified depth buffer) storing ray-cast results from the previous frame to accelerate voxel traversal during camera rotation, exploiting frame-to-frame coherence.
summary: Prediction Buffer Voxel Traversal accelerates volume rendering by storing previous frame depth distances in a prediction buffer to skip or refine ray traversal, optimizing GPU parallelism.
